data.title: About Pittsburgh's Volunteer Animal Rescue
paragraphs: Animal Advocates is a nonprofit, all-volunteer, Pittsburgh-based animal welfare organization involved in the rescue, care, and placement of companion cats and dogs. Serving the Pittsburgh area since 1984, we have adhered to a no-kill policy and engaged in community-based advocacy on behalf of animals since our inception.

We aim to provide high-quality care for the well-being of rescued cats and dogs until they are placed in forever homes. Except for a limited number of cats fostered at our headquarters in the West End, our adoptable animals are cared for in loving volunteer foster homes.
